searchText: ***CONSIGNMENT*** Used Dynamax Class C RV for sale - 2020 Dynamax Isata 3 24FW is approximately 24' 7' in length with 26,764 miles and 1 slide. Features Full Wall Slide BAthroom Skylight More About This RV This 24FW Class C diesel motorhome gives you the luxuries of home while traveling on the road! The full wall slide out helps to really open up the interior when you are parked. When you aren't enjoying a meal or playing a card game at the booth dinette, you can head to the rear and relax on the gel-infused memory foam queen-size bed while you watch your favorite movie on the 32' LED TV. You won't have to leave anything behind either thanks to the exterior storage area, the underbed storage, and the overhead cabinets throughout the inside. You're going to love getting clean in the rear corner bathroom with the Oxygenics body spa RV shower head and the residential vanity with a stainless steel sink provides the perfect spot for you to get ready! You will find that each one of these Dynamax isata 3 Class C diesel motorhomes are different by design with dark-tinted frameless windows, an aerodynamic fiberglass front cap with cab-over cabinets, and full body paint packages with a front-end diamond shield. Each model is built with a Mercedes-Benz® Sprinter chassis, the Truma® Aqua Go Comfort™ on-demand water heater, and MaxxAir® power vents so you know you're getting an efficient motorhome. You can be sure to have a peace of mind while you travel thanks to the aluminum truss structured roof with a crowned, one-piece fiberglass skin. Start doing things different with one of these Dynamax isata 3 Class C diesel motorhomes today!
